title: License qualification as a gate on Genesis's signed auto-attach of installed packages
problem: Genesis attached an installed open-source package under a founder-signed read-only auto_attach whatever its declared license (undeclared, BUSL, AGPL, proprietary). Technical qualification existed; legal qualification did not.
baseline: #196 a3fa3795: Mechanism Card holds license_of() display string; Genesis._attach and _attach_dependency never read it.

alternatives.name: Proposed: packaging.licenses + fail-closed obligation table + attach gate
alternatives.description: Parse SPDX with PyPA packaging; classify six obligation classes for GREG's use; auto-attach only cleared; founder attach unchanged.
advantages: Covers every future package on the route
disadvantages: Small table sends unusual licenses to founder review

alternatives.name: Strongest competitor: license-expression + ScanCode LicenseDB
alternatives.description: nexB library with categories for over 2,000 licenses.
disadvantages: New dependency and large data set
Categories describe licenses, not GREG's use
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder-review volume from unclassified licenses exceeds a few per month

alternatives.name: Simplest viable: display-only
alternatives.description: Show the assessment to the founder, no gate.
disadvantages: auto_attach still attaches a BUSL package silently

alternatives.name: Block all non-permissive licenses outright
disadvantages: Removes founder decision; blocks lawful local GPL use
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder decides D-LIC-1 in favour of refusal

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: A signed mission continues to attach any installed package regardless of license.
advantages: No change to integrator's merge surface

roles.position: Advances 5.3/6 without banning any package; founder keeps the decision.
evidence_refs: sweep: 2 of 123 installed packages go to review

roles.position: One module, one condition at each existing attach point; no new registry.
Independent agent found a bypass and fail-open parsing; all fixed with tests.
material_concerns: Riders in full license texts undetected

roles.position: No new dependency beyond explicit packaging>=24.2; mutation gate added.
Respects upstream authors' terms; obligations shown before use; not a legal review and says so.
material_concerns: Must not be represented as legal clearance

evidence.claim: Uncleared package is not auto-attached; founder attach closes the mission

evidence.finding: with gate removed BUSL package attaches itself

counterevidence.claim: Phrase scan of full license texts is reliable
counterevidence.finding: false: bundled GPL text says 'noncommercially'; scan limited to short fields

pass_1.intended_outcome: GREG never attaches a legally uncleared package without the founder, and states obligations on every card.

advantages.statement: Gate covers every future package acquisition
advantages.amplified_value: Each new OSS capability inherits legal qualification without per-package work

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Map a family only when every version shares a class
Measure review volume; ScanCode upgrade path recorded

disadvantages.statement: Other attach paths may bypass the gate
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Gate _attach_dependency too; mutants on both conditions

comparisons.reversible_experiment: gate behind one condition; revert restores baseline

pass_2.attack_summary: Independent review attacked bypass paths, parsing quirks, legacy records and misclassifications.

new_weaknesses.statement: Cards recorded before assessments would block permissive packages forever
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Re-assess from the installed distribution at the qualified version

new_weaknesses.statement: A permissive classifier plus a restrictive License field cleared
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Stricter recognised field or restrictive phrase in a short field wins

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: more than a few reviews per month

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: both set_state(ATTACHED) paths gated and mutant-tested
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: any new attach path in genesis.py

pass_2.final_design: greg/licensing.py with fail-closed classes, legacy re-assessment and short-field phrase scan; gate in _attach (after formation-only and cognition guards) and _attach_dependency.

residual_risks.mitigation: stated limit; not a legal review

residual_risks.risk: System binaries, builder output and model weights unassessed

entries.position: A founder-command attach of a license-held package should still be allowed (current behavior).
entries.rationale: The integrator asked that whether to refuse be left to the founder.

migration_plan: Additive card field; legacy cards are re-assessed on read; no data migration.

steps: Revert the licensed condition in Genesis._attach and _attach_dependency
The card field is inert without the gate

kill_criteria: A cleared engine (networkx, scipy, ortools) stops auto-attaching on a supported body
Founder rules license gating out of scope
review_trigger: Integrator intake of #201 or founder review
